scripts.dev:frontend: npm run check:node && npm run start --workspace frontend
scripts.dev:backend: npm run check:node && npm run dev --workspace backend
scripts.build: npm run check:node && npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.db:migrate: npm run check:node && npm run prisma7:migrate --workspace backend
scripts.prisma8:emit: npm run check:node && npm run prisma8:emit --workspace backend
scripts.db:setup: npm run check:node && npm run prisma7:generate --workspace backend && npm run db:setup --workspace backend
scripts.db:seed: npm run check:node && npm run db:seed --workspace backend
scripts.test:e2e: npm run check:node && npx --no-install playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:ui: npm run check:node && npx --no-install playwright test --ui
